stories.title: Fever GM defends fanbase: Attacks have no basis in reality, must stop
stories.summary: General manager Amber Cox defended the Fever fanbase during her end-of-season news conference, saying the "attacks on our fanbase have no basis in reality."

stories.title: Mississippi St. QB Taylor, amid Heisman hype, exits early vs. Bama
stories.summary: Mississippi State star quarterback Kamario Taylor, a Heisman Trophy favorite entering the weekend, headed to the locker room early in the fourth quarter vs. Alabama.

stories.title: LeBron, Brown scrimmage for 76ers as fans flock for first look
stories.summary: Throngs of fans waited in lines more than 10-deep to watch LeBron James, Jaylen Brown and the rest of the 76ers take part in Saturday's scrimmage.

stories.title: Source: Bears expected to start QB Bagent vs. Jets
stories.summary: The Bears are expected to start Tyson Bagent at quarterback against the Jets, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Fever's Mitchell says she'll be 'selfish' with free agency decision
stories.summary: Retaining unrestricted free agent Kelsey Mitchell is a top offseason priority for the Fever, according to general manager Amber Cox and coach Stephanie White.
